tasks.label: K8s Debug Pods
tasks.command: kubectl get pods -o wide; echo '---LOGS---'; kubectl logs -l app=inference --tail=50 2>&1; echo '---EVENTS---'; kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20

tasks.label: K8s Debug
tasks.command: kubectl get pods -o wide && echo ---LOGS--- && kubectl logs -l app=inference --tail=50 && echo ---EVENTS--- && kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp

tasks.label: Inference Debug
tasks.command: kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide && echo ---FULL-LOGS--- && kubectl logs -l app=inference --all-containers 2>&1

tasks.label: Debug Model
tasks.command: curl -s http://localhost:8080/gateway/inference/models 2>&1 && echo ---READY--- && curl -s http://localhost:8080/gateway/inference/ready 2>&1 && echo ---LOGS--- && kubectl logs -l app=inference --tail=100 2>&1 | findstr /V "/ready" | findstr /V "/health"

tasks.label: SSL Check
tasks.command: kubectl exec deployment/inference -- python -c "import urllib.request; print(urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/ready').read().decode())" && echo --- && kubectl exec deployment/inference -- cat /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt | findstr workspace && echo --- && kubectl exec deployment/inference -- env | findstr SSL

inputs.description: Python package name to add (e.g. fastapi)
